artifacts.ticketInstructions: 宿主后端持有 ApiKey 并向网关换取短期应用票据；浏览器仅接收 ticket，禁止嵌入长期 ApiKey。

<script src="http://127.0.0.1:15174/assistant.js"></script>
<script>
AIAssistant.init({endpoint:"http://127.0.0.1:18080",appCode:"satellite-planning-assistant",ticket:async()=>{const response=await fetch('/your-backend/ticket',{method:'POST'});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('ticket exchange failed');const body=await response.json();return body.data.ticket;}});
</script>
